look.why: A warm savanna-ochre amber that sets off its striking black-and-white shoulder stripe and huge plumed tail.

size.measure: total length, 1.8–2.4 m including bushy tail

habitat.text: Grasslands, savannas, wetlands and tropical forests of Central and South America.

diet.text: Up to 30,000 ants and termites a day, flicked up at 150 times per minute with a sticky 60-cm tongue.

facts.text: Completely toothless—it crushes insects against hard ridges on the roof of its mouth and muscular stomach.
It walks on its knuckles with its huge front claws tucked inward so they stay razor-sharp for tearing termite mounds.

id.habitat: Padang rumput, sabana, lahan basah, dan hutan tropis di Amerika Tengah dan Amerika Selatan.
id.diet: Hingga 30.000 semut dan rayap per hari, dijilat 150 kali per menit dengan lidah lengket sepanjang 60 cm.
facts: Sama sekali tidak bergigi—ia menghancurkan serangga pada langit-langit mulut keras dan lambung berototnya.
Ia berjalan di atas buku-buku jarinya dengan cakar depan raksasa terlipat agar tetap tajam untuk membongkar sarang rayap.
